instruction: Using the On-Screen Keyboard, find information about telehealth appointments and save the eligibility requirements in a document named telehealth_eligibility.txt on the Desktop.
gt_steps: Using the On-Screen Keyboard, search for information about telehealth appointments.
Open a relevant healthcare or government website about telehealth appointments.
Find the eligibility requirements for telehealth appointments.
Type or copy the eligibility requirements into the document.
Save the document as telehealth_eligibility.txt on the Desktop.
Leave the saved document on the Desktop.
